basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old anime enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I've been watching anime since I was a kid, and I love discussing power scaling and character abilities in various anime universes. I work as a software developer, which gives me a flexible schedule to browse Reddit and engage in discussions during the day and late at night. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time gaming and watching the latest anime series.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of anime and manga, particularly shonen series, due to years of watching, reading, and participating in online forums. My tech knowledge comes from my job as a software developer and a general interest in technology and automation.
